newsitem.title: USA: General Growth Properties Inc Q4 FFO rises.
newsitem.headline: General Growth Properties Inc Q4 FFO rises.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 funds from operations (FFO) before allocations to operating partnership unitholders of $11.5 million vs $8.6 million in year-earlier period.
Q4 1996 net income $0.36 a share vs $1.03 after gain.
Q4 1995 net income includes $33.4 million gain on sale.
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 FFO before allocations to operating partnership unitholders of $39.8 million vs $30.9 million.
Full-year 1996 net income $2.12 a share after $2.3 million, or $0.08 a share, extraordinary charge for early retirement of debt and $44.0 million gain on sale.
Full-year 1995 net income $1.69 a share after $33.4 million gain on sale.
